title: CACHES OFF THE MAP
why: His order 2026-10-29: quit showing caches on the map, even if player burns a data slot. It makes the map super messy. Watch: the map no longer marks caches.
now: Both maps hide cache marks and words with or without intel. The Stray reward keeps one plain ring. Strongbox, locked rooms and other objectives stay. LOCAL: no linked review. Retargets: cw-nocachelbl 33.42, cw-cx-sectorhold-o03 32.27, cw-cx-mapstart-clear 33.54, cw-cx-mapquiet-o03 32.33 and cw-cx-mapspace-o03 32.30 accept old cache marks or the new hidden caches while preserving their other checks.
